WITH cis_attrs AS (
  SELECT
    c.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    c.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    h.`CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP` AS CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP,
    COALESCE(h.`DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN`, h.`DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM`) AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
    c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
    c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS RAW_DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM `cis_course_catalog` c
  LEFT JOIN `cis_hass_attribute` h
    ON c.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` = h.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE`
  WHERE c.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
    AND c.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
),
hass_subjects AS (
  -- filter to CIS attribute group 'H' and exclude empty terms/subjects
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_ID
  FROM cis_attrs
  WHERE CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP = 'H'
    AND TRIM(TERM_CODE) <> ''
    AND TRIM(SUBJECT_ID) <> ''
),
term_descriptions AS (
  -- prefer academic_terms, fall back to academic_terms_all
  SELECT
    at.`TERM_CODE`,
    at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`
  FROM `academic_terms` at
  WHERE at.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ata.`TERM_CODE`,
    ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`
  FROM `academic_terms_all` ata
  WHERE ata.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
    -- exclude term_codes already present from academic_terms to keep preference
    AND ata.`TERM_CODE` NOT IN (SELECT `TERM_CODE` FROM `academic_terms`)
),
term_desc_dedup AS (
  -- keep one description per TERM_CODE (academic_terms rows preferred by previous union)
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    TERM_DESCRIPTION
  FROM term_descriptions
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
)
SELECT
  hs.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  td.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  hs.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- SCHOOL_NAME is not present in schema; attempt to derive from DEPARTMENT_NAME by taking part before ' - ' if common,
  -- otherwise return DEPARTMENT_NAME as SCHOOL_NAME placeholder (keeps joinable id columns per instructions).
  CASE
    WHEN hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN LOCATE(' - ', hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME) > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ' - ', 1))
    ELSE hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  END AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT hs.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_SUBJECTS
FROM hass_subjects hs
LEFT JOIN term_desc_dedup td
  ON hs.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  hs.TERM_CODE,
  td.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  hs.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME
ORDER BY
  hs.TERM_CODE ASC,
  hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC

fac_rooms_space_area AS (

LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_floor ff
  ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
),
fac_building_floor_room_aggs AS (
SELECT
  b.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  -- minimum non-null floor identifier (string comparison)
  MIN(f.`FLOOR`) AS `MIN_FLOOR`,
  -- maximum non-null floor identifier (string comparison)
  MAX(f.`FLOOR`) AS `MAX_FLOOR`,
  -- sum of room AREA treating NULL as 0
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(fr.`AREA`, 0)), 0) AS `TOTAL_ROOM_AREA`,
  -- count of distinct non-null floor rows for this building in fac_floor (if fac_floor has duplicate floor rows, adjust as needed)
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.`FLOOR_KEY`) AS `FLOOR_ROW_COUNT`,
  -- count of room rows in fac_rooms_space_area for this building

  -- start from buildings to ensure one row per building_key even when there are no floors/rooms

  -- fac_floor table is not listed in schema extract but is referenced in the requirement.

SELECT
  SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY,
  TERM_CODE,
  MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,
  MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
  MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  COURSE_NUMBER,
  COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
  COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
  SUBJECT_ID,
  SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  SECTION_ID,
  IS_MASTER_SECTION,
  IS_LECTURE_SECTION,
  IS_LAB_SECTION,
  IS_RECITATION_SECTION,
  IS_DESIGN_SECTION,
  OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
  RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  MEET_TIME,
  MEET_PLACE,
  CLUSTER_TYPE,
  CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC,
  CLUSTER_LIST,
  HGN_CODE,
  HGN_CODE_DESC,
  FORM_TYPE,
  FORM_TYPE_DESC,
  SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  EVALUATE_THIS_SUBJECT,
  IS_OSE_SUBJECT,
  IS_CREATED_BY_DATA_WAREHOUSE,
  SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY,
  WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
  IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY SECTION_ID
    ORDER BY COALESCE(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '') DESC, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY DESC
  ) AS section_row_rank
FROM subject_offered
),
cip_preferred_version AS (
SELECT
  COALESCE(cwv.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_CODE) AS PROGRAM_CODE,
  COALESCE(cwv.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS CATEGORY_CODE,
  COALESCE(cwv.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE) AS CATEGORY_TITLE,
  -- chosen VERSION: prefer cip_with_version.VERSION when present (most recent by WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE),
  -- otherwise fall back to cip.VERSION
  COALESCE(cwv.VERSION, c.VERSION) AS VERSION,
  -- WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE: the load date of the chosen source (cip_with_version if present else cip)
  COALESCE(cwv.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM
  -- base cip table (one row per PROGRAM_CODE)
  cip c
  -- left join to the preferred row from cip_with_version per PROGRAM_CODE.
  -- For cip_with_version we choose the single row with the latest WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE per PROGRAM_CODE.
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      pv.PROGRAM_CODE,
      pv.VERSION,
      pv.CATEGORY_CODE,
      pv.CATEGORY_TITLE,
      pv.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
    FROM (
      SELECT
        cv.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cv.PROGRAM_CODE
                           ORDER BY
                             -- treat WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE as string; convert to DATETIME when possible,
                             -- fallback to the raw string to keep deterministic ordering.
                             STR_TO_DATE(cv.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') DESC,
                             STR_TO_DATE(cv.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') DESC,
                             cv.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE DESC
                          ) AS rn
      FROM cip_with_version cv
    ) pv
    WHERE pv.rn = 1
  ) cwv
    ON cwv.PROGRAM_CODE = c.PROGRAM_CODE
),
subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS (
SELECT
  TERM_CODE,
  SUBJECT_ID,
  SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SCHOOL_CODE,
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_number,
  SUM(COALESCE(CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_cluster_enrollment_number,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_credit,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_listen,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_first_week,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_fifth_week,
  MAX(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS last_warehouse_load_date
FROM subject_summary
GROUP BY
  TERM_CODE,
  SUBJECT_ID,
  SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SCHOOL_CODE,
  SCHOOL_NAME
),
course_description_with_cip_and_dept AS (
SELECT
  -- course identifier: use composite subject+course number if available from subject_offered_latest_by_section,
  -- otherwise fall back to SUBJECT_ID + COURSE_NUMBER combination
  COALESCE(so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY, CONCAT(so.SUBJECT_ID, '-', so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER)) AS `COURSE`,

  -- CIP program code: join to cip (or cip_with_version) by PROGRAM_CODE if available on subject summary enrollment;
  -- lift literal filtering out of view (no hard-coded version selection here)
  c.PROGRAM_CODE AS `CIP_PROGRAM_CODE`,

  -- course level: derive from MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER (take leftmost digits) or use NULL if missing
  CASE
    WHEN so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER, '/', 1) AS CHAR)
    ELSE so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER
  END AS `COURSE_LEVEL`,

  -- is degree granting: infer from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject field SCHOOL_CODE or presence of department;
  -- store as 'Y'/'N' (no literals lifted here)
  CASE
    WHEN sse.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sse.SCHOOL_CODE <> '' THEN 'Y'
    WHEN so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE <> '' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`,

  -- department and department name coming from subject_offered_latest_by_section (OFFER_DEPT_CODE/OFFER_DEPT_NAME)
  so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS `DEPARTMENT`,
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,

  -- school name from subject summary enrollment aggregation or subject_offered_latest_by_section
  COALESCE(sse.SCHOOL_NAME, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,

  -- from / thru term: provide the term_code of the offering row (FROM_TERM) and NULL for THRU_TERM (term ranges not available in sources)
  so.TERM_CODE AS `FROM_TERM`,
  NULL AS `THRU_TERM`,

  -- warehouse load date: prefer the most recent available load date from the joined sources
  COALESCE(so.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, sse.last_warehouse_load_date, c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section AS so
LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS sse
  ON so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = sse.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  AND so.TERM_CODE = sse.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN cip AS c
  -- join CIP by matching department/program mapping: we attempt to join on PROGRAM_CODE = OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  -- (this keeps the view generic; consumers should supply any program-version mapping externally)
  ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY, CONCAT(so.SUBJECT_ID, '-', so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER)),
  c.PROGRAM_CODE,
  CASE
    WHEN so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER, '/', 1) AS CHAR)
    ELSE so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN sse.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sse.SCHOOL_CODE <> '' THEN 'Y'
    WHEN so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE <> '' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END,
  so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  COALESCE(sse.SCHOOL_NAME, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME),
  so.TERM_CODE,
  NULL,
  COALESCE(so.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, sse.last_warehouse_load_date, c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE)
)
SELECT
  cpv.CATEGORY_CODE,
  cpv.CATEGORY_TITLE,
  cpv.VERSION,
  cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  cd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_COURSES_U,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_COURSES_G,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_DEGREE_GRANTING
FROM course_description_with_cip_and_dept AS cd
JOIN cip_preferred_version AS cpv
  ON cd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = cpv.PROGRAM_CODE
WHERE cd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND cpv.CATEGORY_CODE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  cpv.CATEGORY_CODE,
  cpv.CATEGORY_TITLE,
  cpv.VERSION,
  cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  cd.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  cpv.CATEGORY_CODE ASC,
  cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC

library_subject_offered_canonical AS (
SELECT
  lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
  COALESCE(lso.TERM_CODE, sol.TERM_CODE, ssea.TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
  COALESCE(lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, sol.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ssea.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  COALESCE(lso.COURSE_NUMBER, sol.COURSE_NUMBER, ssea.SUBJECT_ID) AS COURSE_NUMBER,
  COALESCE(lso.SUBJECT_ID, sol.SUBJECT_ID, ssea.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,
  COALESCE(lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sol.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ssea.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  COALESCE(lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sol.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ssea.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  COALESCE(lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sol.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ssea.SCHOOL_NAME) AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- Prefer the library table's responsible faculty name, fall back to subject_offered_latest_by_section, then normalized employee directory
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ''),
    NULLIF(sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ''),
    ed.DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME,
    ed.FULL_NAME
  ) AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  -- Prefer MIT id from library table, then subject_offered_latest_by_section, then employee directory lookup by KRB/ID
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, ''),
    NULLIF(sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, ''),
    ed.MIT_ID,
    ed.KRB_NAME
  ) AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  -- Enrollment: prefer explicit library field, else section or subject aggregates
  COALESCE(
    lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    sol.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    ssea.total_subject_enrollment_number
  ) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM

  -- join to latest subject/section summary to enrich canonical fields where library record lacks them
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered_latest_by_section sol
    ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = sol.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
   AND lso.COURSE_NUMBER = sol.COURSE_NUMBER
   AND lso.TERM_CODE = sol.TERM_CODE
  -- join to subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject to get enrollment and department/school metadata
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ssea
    ON COALESCE(lso.TERM_CODE, sol.TERM_CODE) = ssea.TERM_CODE
   AND COALESCE(lso.SUBJECT_ID, sol.SUBJECT_ID, sol.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) = ssea.SUBJECT_ID

  LEFT JOIN employee_directory_contact_normalized ed
    ON ed.MIT_ID = COALESCE(lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID)
    OR ed.KRB_NAME = COALESCE(lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID)
    OR ed.DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME = COALESCE(lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME)
)

  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE AS LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  r.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  r.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  -- total number of distinct courses referenced by the reserve materials for this status+term
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    COALESCE(
      CONCAT(lsoc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, '::', lsoc.COURSE_NUMBER, '::', lsoc.SUBJECT_ID),
      CONCAT(r.SUBJECT_ID, '::', r.COURSE_NUMBER)
    )
  ) AS TOTAL_COURSES,
  -- total number of material-course association rows (materials occurrences)
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_MATERIALS,
  -- number of distinct departments represented among matched canonical offerings
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(lsoc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, '')) AS DEPT_OCCURRENCES,
  -- number of distinct schools represented among matched canonical offerings
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(lsoc.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, '')) AS SCHOOL_OCCURRENCES,
  -- total distinct instructors (responsible faculty from canonical OR instructor names from course instructor table)
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(lsoc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ''), NULLIF(ci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, ''))) AS TOTAL_INSTRUCTORS
FROM
  library_reserve_matrl_detail r
  JOIN library_material_status_lookup_67 lms
    ON r.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered_canonical lsoc
    ON r.TERM_CODE = lsoc.TERM_CODE
   AND r.SUBJECT_ID = lsoc.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN (
    -- pre-aggregate distinct instructor names by term and subject/course to avoid row multiplication
    SELECT DISTINCT
      TERM_CODE,
      SUBJECT_ID,
      COURSE_NUMBER,
      INSTRUCTOR_NAME
    FROM library_course_instructor
  ) ci
    ON r.TERM_CODE = ci.TERM_CODE
   AND (r.SUBJECT_ID = ci.SUBJECT_ID OR r.COURSE_NUMBER = ci.COURSE_NUMBER)
WHERE
  r.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  r.TERM_CODE,
  r.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE ASC,
  r.TERM_CODE ASC

rows.question: For building 36, list all space units, their floor and building name, building street address, their space usage, and the number of organizations and space units on the same building and floor.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
  COALESCE(su.FLOOR, fr.FLOOR) AS FLOOR,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME,
  fba.ADDRESS_LINE_1 AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  suu.SPACE_USAGE AS SPACE_USAGE,
  cohort.ORGANIZATION_COUNT_SAME_BUILDING_FLOOR,
  cohort.SPACE_UNIT_COUNT_SAME_BUILDING_FLOOR
FROM space_unit su
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr
  ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = su.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  AND (fr.SPACE_ID = su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE OR fr.SPACE_ID = su.SPACE_ID)
JOIN fclt_building fb
  ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = su.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address fba
  ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN space_usage suu
  ON suu.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    fr.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.SPACE_ID) AS SPACE_UNIT_COUNT_SAME_BUILDING_FLOOR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS ORGANIZATION_COUNT_SAME_BUILDING_FLOOR
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR
) cohort
  ON cohort.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = su.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  AND cohort.FLOOR = COALESCE(su.FLOOR, fr.FLOOR)
WHERE fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = '36'
  AND su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY FLOOR, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

WITH moira_list_base AS (
SELECT
  `moira_list`.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` AS `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
  `moira_list`.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS `MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
  `moira_list`.`IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST` AS `IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST`,
  `moira_list`.`IS_MOIRA_GROUP` AS `IS_MOIRA_GROUP`,
  `moira_list`.`IS_NFS_GROUP` AS `IS_NFS_GROUP`,
  `moira_list`.`IS_ACTIVE` AS `IS_ACTIVE`
FROM

)
SELECT
  mlb.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlb.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST,
  mlb.IS_MOIRA_GROUP,
  mlb.IS_NFS_GROUP,
  mlo.OWNER,
  mld_counts.MEMBER_COUNT
FROM moira_list_base mlb
JOIN (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)) AS MEMBER_COUNT,

  ON mld_counts.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mlb.MOIRA_LIST_KEY

  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld_counts.OWNER_KEY

  AND mld_counts.MEMBER_COUNT > 1000

If a mailing list has multiple owners, create a separate entry for each owner. Similarly, if multiple lists share the minimum or maximum member count, include all those lists.

    `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,

      WHEN `IS_PUBLIC` IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN `IS_PUBLIC` IN ('Y','N') THEN `IS_PUBLIC`

    CASE

  FROM `moira_list`
  WHERE `MOIRA_LIST_KEY` IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`) <> ''
),
member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COALESCE(d.cnt, 0) AS MEMBER_COUNT
  FROM moira_list_master m
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS cnt
    FROM moira_list_detail
    GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  ) d ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
extrema AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT MAX(MEMBER_COUNT) FROM member_counts) AS max_count,
    (SELECT MIN(MEMBER_COUNT) FROM member_counts) AS min_count
)
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  m.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION,
  o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER AS OWNER,
  m.IS_PUBLIC,
  m.IS_HIDDEN,
  mc.MEMBER_COUNT
FROM moira_list_master m
JOIN member_counts mc ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN moira_list_owner o ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
CROSS JOIN extrema e
WHERE mc.MEMBER_COUNT IN (e.max_count, e.min_count)
ORDER BY mc.MEMBER_COUNT DESC, m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER

rows.question: For email lists with names starting with C (case insensitive) and containing faculty who teach courses in the summer in financial aid years after 2001, provide the name of the list, the number of people in the list, and the number of faculty in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH email_lists AS (
  SELECT
    `LIST_NAME`,
    `PERSON_EMAIL` AS `EMAIL`,
    `PERSON_NAME`,
    `PERSON_NAME_UPPER`
  FROM `drupal_employee_directory`
  WHERE `LIST_NAME` IS NOT NULL
),
lists_c_names AS (
  SELECT
    `LIST_NAME`,
    `EMAIL`,
    `PERSON_NAME`,
    `PERSON_NAME_UPPER`
  FROM email_lists
  WHERE LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(`PERSON_NAME_UPPER`, UPPER(`PERSON_NAME`))),1) = 'C'
),
faculty_summer AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    d.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS `MIT_ID`,
    COALESCE(CONCAT_WS(' ', e.`FIRST_NAME`, e.`LAST_NAME`), e.`FULL_NAME`) AS `FAC_NAME`,
    atp.`FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR`,
    atp.`TERM_CODE`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` d
  JOIN `academic_terms` atp
    ON d.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` = atp.`TERM_CODE`
  LEFT JOIN `employee_directory` e
    ON d.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` = e.`MIT_ID`
  WHERE atp.`TERM_CODE` LIKE '%SU'
    AND CAST(LEFT(atp.`TERM_CODE`,4) AS UNSIGNED) > 2001
    AND d.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
),
faculty_emails AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l.`LIST_NAME`,
    l.`EMAIL`,
    l.`PERSON_NAME`,
    ed.`MIT_ID`
  FROM lists_c_names l
  LEFT JOIN `employee_directory` ed
    ON (
         ed.`EMAIL_ADDRESS` IS NOT NULL
         AND LOWER(TRIM(ed.`EMAIL_ADDRESS`)) = LOWER(TRIM(l.`EMAIL`))
       )
       OR (
         ed.`FULL_NAME` IS NOT NULL
         AND LOWER(TRIM(ed.`FULL_NAME`)) = LOWER(TRIM(l.`PERSON_NAME`))
       )
)
SELECT
  fe.`LIST_NAME` AS `list_name`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fe.`EMAIL`) AS `people_in_list`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fs.`MIT_ID`) AS `faculty_in_list`
FROM faculty_emails fe
LEFT JOIN faculty_summer fs
  ON fe.`MIT_ID` = fs.`MIT_ID`
WHERE fe.`LIST_NAME` LIKE '%MOIRA%'
GROUP BY fe.`LIST_NAME`

rows.question: For faculty who are responsible for courses in 2023 fall term, list the name of mailing lists with ten members that they subscribe to, the number of faculty in these lists, and the number of courses associated with those faculty.

WITH subject_offered_latest_by_section AS (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY,
    TERM_CODE,
    MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,
    MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
    MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    COURSE_NUMBER,
    COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
    COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SECTION_ID,
    IS_MASTER_SECTION,
    IS_LECTURE_SECTION,
    IS_LAB_SECTION,
    IS_RECITATION_SECTION,
    IS_DESIGN_SECTION,
    OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    MEET_TIME,
    MEET_PLACE,
    CLUSTER_TYPE,
    CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC,
    CLUSTER_LIST,
    HGN_CODE,
    HGN_CODE_DESC,
    FORM_TYPE,
    FORM_TYPE_DESC,
    SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,

    EVALUATE_THIS_SUBJECT,

    SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY,
    WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
    IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY SECTION_ID
      ORDER BY COALESCE(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '') DESC, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY DESC
    ) AS section_row_rank
  FROM subject_offered
),
employee_directory_contact_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    MIT_ID,
    LAST_NAME,
    FIRST_NAME,
    MIDDLE_NAME,
    FULL_NAME,
    DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME,
    OFFICE_LOCATION,
    OFFICE_PHONE,
    DIRECTORY_TITLE,
    PRIMARY_TITLE,
    DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    KRB_NAME,
    KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE,
    EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    PERSONAL_URL,
    NAME_KNOWN_BY,
    EMAIL_ADDRESS_UPPERCASE,
    FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE,
    COALESCE(PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME, FIRST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME,
    COALESCE(PREFERRED_LAST_NAME, LAST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_LAST_NAME,
    COALESCE(PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME, MIDDLE_NAME) AS PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME
  FROM employee_directory
),
course_responsible_faculty_by_term AS (
  SELECT
    s.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    s.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    s.COURSE_NUMBER AS COURSE_NUMBER,
    s.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
    s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    COALESCE(ed.FULL_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    -- carry through the natural grain key so the view stays joinable
    s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
  FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section s
  LEFT JOIN employee_directory_contact_normalized ed
    ON s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
  WHERE s.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND (s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY IS NOT NULL)
    -- keep only the latest row per section (section_row_rank = 1)
    AND s.section_row_rank = 1
)
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS NUM_FACULTY_ON_LIST,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN cr.TERM_CODE = '2023FA' THEN COALESCE(cr.SUBJECT_ID, CONCAT(cr.SUBJECT_ID, '|', cr.COURSE_NUMBER))
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS NUM_COURSES_ASSOCIATED_WITH_THOSE_FACULTY
FROM moira_list AS m
JOIN moira_list_detail AS d
  ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN course_responsible_faculty_by_term AS cr
  ON cr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  AND cr.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
GROUP BY m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) = 10
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cr.TERM_CODE = '2023FA' THEN cr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ELSE NULL END) > 0
ORDER BY m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: For each course instructor in the 'keeper-zephyr' mailing list, provide the name of mailing lists they subscribe to, instructor name, earliest and latest publication years, and total number of enrolled students.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
  COALESCE(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME,
           NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, ''),
           icl.instructor_name) AS instructor_name,
  MIN(CAST(NULLIF(tm.YEAR, '') AS SIGNED)) AS earliest_publication_year,
  MAX(CAST(NULLIF(tm.YEAR, '') AS SIGNED)) AS latest_publication_year,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(icl.num_enrolled_students, 0)), 0) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM moira_list ml
JOIN moira_list_detail mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  AND ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'keeper-zephyr'
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(ed.FULL_NAME, sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS instructor_name,
    COALESCE(ed.MIT_ID, sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS instructor_mit_id,
    sol.source_table,
    CAST(sol.source_key AS CHAR) AS source_key,
    sol.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    sol.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
    COALESCE(sol.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sol.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0) AS num_enrolled_students
  FROM (
    SELECT
      'course_catalog_subject_offered' AS source_table,
      CAST(SECTION_ID AS CHAR) AS source_key,
      TERM_CODE,
      SUBJECT_ID,
      RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
      RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
      NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
      NULL AS SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      'drupal_course_catalog' AS source_table,
      CAST(SECTION_ID AS CHAR) AS source_key,
      EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
      SUBJECT_ID,
      RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
      RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
      NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
      NULL AS SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
    FROM drupal_course_catalog
  ) sol
  LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed
    ON (ed.MIT_ID = sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID)
       OR (ed.FULL_NAME = sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME)
) icl
  ON (
       (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
         AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID <> ''
         AND icl.instructor_mit_id IS NOT NULL
         AND icl.instructor_mit_id <> ''
         AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = icl.instructor_mit_id)
     OR (
         (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NULL OR mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = '')
         AND LOWER(COALESCE(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '')) = LOWER(COALESCE(icl.instructor_name, ''))
        )
     )
LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
  ON (
       (icl.source_table = 'subject_offered_latest_by_section' AND icl.source_key = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY)
       OR (
            icl.term_code IS NOT NULL AND icl.term_code <> ''
            AND icl.subject_id IS NOT NULL AND icl.subject_id <> ''
            AND td.TERM_CODE = icl.term_code AND td.SUBJECT_ID = icl.subject_id
          )
     )
LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
         COALESCE(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME,
                  NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, ''),
                  icl.instructor_name)
ORDER BY instructor_name ASC

rows.question: For each unique mailing list with a name beginning with R (case insensitive), and that Professor Ayden Hopkins is subscribed to, list its name, description, owner, number of people in the list, and number of tenured faculty in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_list_owner_ref AS (
  SELECT
    `MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY`,
    `OWNER`,
    `OWNER_TYPE`
  FROM `moira_list_owner`
),
moira_list_membership AS (
  SELECT
    `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME`,
    `LAST_UPDATE_DATE`
  FROM `moira_list_detail`
)
SELECT
  m.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
  m.`MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION`,
  o.`OWNER` AS MOIRA_LIST_OWNER,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(mm.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`, mm.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`)) AS total_members,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.`PAYROLL_RANK` = 'Faculty Tenured'
                      THEN COALESCE(mm.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`, mm.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`)
                 END) AS tenured_faculty_count
FROM `moira_list` AS m
LEFT JOIN moira_list_owner_ref AS o
  ON o.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY` = (SELECT `MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY` FROM `moira_list` WHERE `MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` LIMIT 1)
JOIN moira_list_membership AS mm
  ON m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mm.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
LEFT JOIN `se_person` AS p
  ON p.`MIT_ID` = mm.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`
WHERE m.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` LIKE 'R%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM moira_list_membership AS mm2
    WHERE mm2.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
      AND mm2.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME` = 'Hopkins, Ayden'
  )
GROUP BY
  m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
  m.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
  m.`MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION`,
  o.`OWNER`
ORDER BY m.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`

rows.question: For the email list with name 'date-destiny', list the name of the list, department name, the number of students from the Management department, and the percentage of students who are from the Management department, rounded to two decimal places.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH employee_directory_contact_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    MIT_ID,
    LAST_NAME,
    FIRST_NAME,
    MIDDLE_NAME,
    FULL_NAME,
    DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME,
    OFFICE_LOCATION,
    OFFICE_PHONE,
    DIRECTORY_TITLE,
    PRIMARY_TITLE,
    DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    KRB_NAME,
    KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE,
    EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    PERSONAL_URL,
    NAME_KNOWN_BY,
    EMAIL_ADDRESS_UPPERCASE,
    FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE,
    COALESCE(PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME, FIRST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME,
    COALESCE(PREFERRED_LAST_NAME, LAST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_LAST_NAME,
    COALESCE(PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME, MIDDLE_NAME) AS PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME
  FROM employee_directory
),
student_to_sis_admin_department_keyed AS (
  SELECT
    -- person_identifier to join from moira membership when MIT_ID might be absent;
    -- prefer KRB_NAME if present, else MIT_ID
    COALESCE(NULLIF(KRB_NAME, ''), NULLIF(MIT_ID, '')) AS person_identifier,
    MIT_ID,
    DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized
  WHERE MIT_ID IS NOT NULL OR KRB_NAME IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  'Management' AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(management_counts.MANAGEMENT_STUDENT_COUNT, 0) AS MANAGEMENT_STUDENT_COUNT,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COALESCE(management_counts.MANAGEMENT_STUDENT_COUNT, 0) /
    NULLIF(COALESCE(total_counts.TOTAL_STUDENT_COUNT, 0), 0),
    2
  ) AS MANAGEMENT_PERCENTAGE
FROM moira_list m
LEFT JOIN (
  -- total distinct, non-empty members on the list: prefer MIT_ID when present, otherwise the member string
  SELECT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS TOTAL_STUDENT_COUNT
  FROM (
    SELECT
      MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
      NULLIF(CASE WHEN COALESCE(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') <> '' THEN MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID ELSE MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER END, '') AS member_id
    FROM moira_list_detail
    WHERE COALESCE(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') <> '' OR COALESCE(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '') <> ''
  ) d
  GROUP BY d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
) total_counts ON total_counts.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- distinct members on the list who map to SIS admin department 'MANAGEMENT' (case-insensitive)
  SELECT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS MANAGEMENT_STUDENT_COUNT
  FROM (
    SELECT
      MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
      NULLIF(CASE WHEN COALESCE(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') <> '' THEN MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID ELSE MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER END, '') AS member_id
    FROM moira_list_detail
    WHERE COALESCE(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') <> '' OR COALESCE(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '') <> ''
  ) d
  JOIN student_to_sis_admin_department_keyed s
    -- try to match by MIT_ID first (member_id = MIT_ID), otherwise attempt matching by KRB/person_identifier
    ON (
      s.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND s.MIT_ID = d.member_id
    ) OR (
      s.person_identifier IS NOT NULL AND s.person_identifier = d.member_id
    )
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, '')) = 'MANAGEMENT'
  GROUP BY d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
) management_counts ON management_counts.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'date-destiny'

rows.question: For the building with the most floors, list the building name and the names of the mailing lists staring with a (case insensitive) that the building employees with kerberos starting with c (case insensitive) subscribe to.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_rooms_space_area AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fr.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
    fr.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_KEY,
    fr.ROOM,
    fr.SPACE_ID,
    fr.MAJOR_USE_KEY,
    fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC,
    fr.USE_KEY,
    fr.USE_DESC,
    fr.MINOR_USE_KEY,
    fr.MINOR_USE_DESC,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION,
    fr.AREA,
    fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    fr.DEPT_CODE,
    fr.ACCESS_LEVEL,
    fr.LATITUDE_WGS,
    fr.LONGITUDE_WGS,
    fr.NORTHING_SPCS,
    fr.EASTING_SPCS,
    fr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
),
building_floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    f.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(f.FLOOR), '')) AS distinct_floor_count
  FROM fac_rooms_space_area f
  GROUP BY f.BUILDING_KEY
),
max_floor_buildings AS (
  SELECT bfc.BUILDING_KEY, bfc.distinct_floor_count
  FROM building_floor_counts bfc
  JOIN (SELECT MAX(distinct_floor_count) AS max_floors FROM building_floor_counts) mf
    ON bfc.distinct_floor_count = mf.max_floors
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, bld.BUILDING_NAME, bld.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  ed.MIT_ID,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
FROM max_floor_buildings mfb
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb ON mfb.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN buildings bld ON mfb.BUILDING_KEY = bld.BUILDING_KEY

-- match employees by OFFICE_LOCATION to building name or number (case-insensitive)
LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed
  ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
  AND (
       (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ed.OFFICE_LOCATION) = LOWER(fb.BUILDING_NAME))
    OR (fb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ed.OFFICE_LOCATION) = LOWER(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER))
    OR (bld.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ed.OFFICE_LOCATION) = LOWER(bld.BUILDING_NAME))
    OR (bld.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ed.OFFICE_LOCATION) = LOWER(bld.BUILDING_NUMBER))
  )

-- derive kerberos name from employee_directory (KRB_NAME column exists there)
-- require kerberos starting with 'c' (case-insensitive)
JOIN (
  SELECT MIT_ID, KRB_NAME
  FROM employee_directory
  WHERE KRB_NAME IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(KRB_NAME) LIKE 'c%'
) kerb ON kerb.MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID

-- moira membership details and list names
JOIN moira_list_detail mld ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = kerb.MIT_ID
JOIN moira_list ml ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY

-- mailing lists starting with 'a' (case-insensitive)
WHERE LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'a%'
ORDER BY BUILDING_NAME, ed.MIT_ID, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: For the email lists subscribed by faculty members with last names begin with Y, list the names of the lists, the total number of subjects managed by faculty in those mailing lists, and the number of such faculty in the lists.

rows.question: For students with last names starting with H who are subscribed to mailing list 'beacon-date-date', list the names of the students, the phone numbers of departments they belong to, and the size of the mailing list 'beacon-date-date' that they are subscribed to.

-- Corrected query to satisfy the requested intent.
-- Notes:
-- 1) The provided schema does not include explicit Moira or student tables with the expected column names.
--    I use the tables/columns from the user's schema where reasonable best-matches exist:
--      - Use drupal_employee_directory / employee_directory for person/name/phone data (employee tables exist).
--      - Use drupal_course_catalog / drupal_course_catalog.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID as a stand-in for a person ID where needed.
--    Where an exact table/column from the request (e.g., moira_list, moira_list_detail, mit_student_directory, sis_admin_department)
--    does not exist in the supplied schema, I create an inline members CTE to represent the moira_list and moira_list_detail data.
-- 2) The query returns student_full_name, department_phone_number (nullable), and mailing_list_size (count of distinct members).
-- 3) Keep key/id columns so view remains joinable.

WITH
-- Replace this CTE with the real moira_list and moira_list_detail tables when available.
-- Schema assumed for real tables:
--   moira_list(MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_NAME)
--   moira_list_detail(MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID)
moira_members AS (
  SELECT
    'beacon-date-date' AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    '12345' AS MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID UNION ALL
  SELECT 'beacon-date-date', '23456' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'beacon-date-date', '34567' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'other-list', '99999'
),
-- Count distinct members for the target list
target_list AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS mailing_list_size
  FROM moira_members
  WHERE MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'beacon-date-date'
  GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_NAME
),
-- Identify members (as MIT IDs) of the target list
target_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS mit_id
  FROM moira_members
  WHERE MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'beacon-date-date'
)
-- Main select:
SELECT
  -- student_full_name: prefer mit_student_directory or person tables; use available drupal_course_catalog.master_subject_id join to directory tables
  COALESCE(ed.FULL_NAME, dd.FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS student_full_name,
  -- department_phone_number: prefer employee_directory.OFFICE_PHONE (or drupal_employee_directory.OFFICE_PHONE)
  COALESCE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, dd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS department_phone_number,
  -- mailing_list_size: same for every returned row (size of 'beacon-date-date')
  COALESCE(tl.mailing_list_size, 0) AS mailing_list_size
FROM target_members tm
-- Attempt to join to known person/directory tables. We try multiple possible ID columns:
LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed
  ON ed.MIT_ID = tm.mit_id
LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory dd
  ON dd.MIT_ID = tm.mit_id
-- As a fallback, join to drupal_course_catalog using MASTER_SUBJECT_ID as a surrogate person id
LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog c
  ON c.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tm.mit_id
-- bring in the mailing list size (single-row)
LEFT JOIN target_list tl
  ON tl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'beacon-date-date'
-- Filter to only people whose last name starts with 'H' (case-insensitive).
-- Prefer ed.LAST_NAME then dd.LAST_NAME then c.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE / SUBJECT_TITLE
WHERE (
    (ed.LAST_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ed.LAST_NAME LIKE 'H%')
 OR (dd.LAST_NAME IS NOT NULL AND dd.LAST_NAME LIKE 'H%')
 OR (c.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND c.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE LIKE 'H%')
 OR (c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND c.SUBJECT_TITLE LIKE 'H%')
)

rows.question: For each department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, what is the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, and what is the average number of enrolled students for all such courses in that department, considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5, and only including departments of Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5)? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_offered_latest_by_section AS (
  SELECT
    so.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY so.SECTION_ID
      ORDER BY COALESCE(so.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '') DESC, so.SECTION_ID DESC
    ) AS section_row_rank
  FROM subject_offered so
),
subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_number,
    MAX(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS last_warehouse_load_date
  FROM subject_summary
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
department_course_enrollments_yr_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    so.TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '')) AS DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL,
    COALESCE(ss.total_subject_enrollment_number, so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    so.COURSE_NUMBER,
    so.SECTION_ID
  FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section so
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
    ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
   AND so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE so.section_row_rank = 1
)
SELECT
  dm.DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  dm.max_enrollment AS MAX_ENROLLMENT,
  -- choose one responsible faculty for a course that has the max enrollment (any one; deterministic via MIN)
  MIN(d.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  da.avg_enrollment AS AVG_ENROLLMENT
FROM (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL,
    MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment
  FROM department_course_enrollments_yr_cohort
  WHERE DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry')
    AND TERM_CODE LIKE '%2019%'
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL
) AS dm
JOIN (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL,
    AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment
  FROM department_course_enrollments_yr_cohort
  WHERE DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry')
    AND TERM_CODE LIKE '%2019%'
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL
) AS da USING (DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL)
JOIN department_course_enrollments_yr_cohort d
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL = dm.DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL
 AND d.TERM_CODE LIKE '%2019%'
 AND d.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER = dm.max_enrollment
WHERE dm.max_enrollment > 5
GROUP BY
  dm.DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL,
  dm.max_enrollment,
  da.avg_enrollment
ORDER BY dm.DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL

WITH subject_codes_by_department AS (
  SELECT
    sod.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sod.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS sod
  WHERE sod.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND sod.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL
),
departments_by_school AS (
  -- derive one row per department with its school and a numeric dept budget code value
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    MAX(DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    MAX(SCHOOL_CODE) AS SCHOOL_CODE,
    MAX(SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    -- use DEPT_BUDGET_CODE source: prefer sis/summary SCHOOL_CODE+DEPARTMENT_CODE when both present,
    -- otherwise fall back to DEPARTMENT_CODE. Cast to numeric where possible: try integer then decimal, else NULL.
    -- Keep the underlying string as well so joins remain on department_code.
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(SCHOOL_CODE) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(SCHOOL_CODE) <> '' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> ''
        THEN CONCAT(MAX(SCHOOL_CODE), '-', DEPARTMENT_CODE)
      WHEN DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> ''
        THEN DEPARTMENT_CODE
      ELSE NULL
    END AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE_STR
  FROM subject_summary
  WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
-- A mapping of schools that have at least one department named exactly 'Political Science'
schools_with_political_science_flag AS (
  SELECT
    s.SCHOOL_CODE,
    s.SCHOOL_NAME,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_political_science_department
  FROM subject_summary s
  WHERE s.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_CODE, s.SCHOOL_NAME
)

  swp.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_full_name,
  -- STDDEV must operate on numeric values. Attempt to cast department budget codes to DECIMAL.

rows.question: For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science), provide the department name, school name, the total number of unique courses they offer, and indicate whether the department is a 'LARGE_DEPT' (if it offers at least 20% more courses than the average among these departments), 'SMALL_DEPT' (if it offers at least 20% fewer), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_CODE,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_number,
    MAX(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS last_warehouse_load_date
  FROM subject_summary
  GROUP BY
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_CODE,
    SCHOOL_NAME
),
dept_unique_course_counts AS (
  -- count distinct SUBJECT_ID per department (across terms/years aggregated above)
  SELECT
    s.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    s.SCHOOL_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject s
  GROUP BY
    s.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    s.SCHOOL_NAME
),
degree_granting_departments AS (
  -- determine degree-granting flag when sis_department exists; treat truthy text as degree-granting
  SELECT
    duc.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(d.SCHOOL_NAME, duc.SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    -- Interpret IS_DEGREE_GRANTING: consider 'Y','y','true','1' etc. as truthy.
    CASE
      WHEN d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING IS NOT NULL THEN
        (LOWER(TRIM(d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING)) IN ('y','yes','true','1'))
      ELSE
        TRUE -- if sis_department missing flag, keep department (assume degree-granting based on presence in subject_summary)
    END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
  FROM dept_unique_course_counts duc
  LEFT JOIN sis_department d
    ON duc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT
    duc.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    duc.SCHOOL_NAME,
    duc.TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES
  FROM dept_unique_course_counts duc
  JOIN degree_granting_departments dgd
    ON duc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dgd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE dgd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = TRUE
    AND COALESCE(duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') <> 'Political Science'
  ORDER BY duc.TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES DESC, duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC
  LIMIT 10
),
top10_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES) AS avg_top10 FROM top10
)
SELECT
  t.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  t.SCHOOL_NAME,
  t.TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES,
  CASE
    WHEN t.TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES >= ta.avg_top10 * 1.20 THEN 'LARGE_DEPT'
    WHEN t.TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES <= ta.avg_top10 * 0.80 THEN 'SMALL_DEPT'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE'
  END AS DEPARTMENT_SIZE_LABEL
FROM top10 t
CROSS JOIN top10_avg ta
ORDER BY t.TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES DESC, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC

rows.question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms where the material status is 'U' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), and only include those academic years where this geometric mean is greater than the overall geometric mean of total units for all such subjects across all years? Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH term_academic_years AS (
  SELECT
    at.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
    at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC` AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`
  FROM (
    SELECT `TERM_CODE`, `ACADEMIC_YEAR`, `TERM_START_DATE`, `TERM_END_DATE`, `ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`
    FROM `academic_terms`
    WHERE `TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT `TERM_CODE`, `ACADEMIC_YEAR`, `TERM_START_DATE`, `TERM_END_DATE`, `ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`
    FROM `academic_terms_all`
    WHERE `TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
      AND `TERM_CODE` NOT IN (SELECT `TERM_CODE` FROM `academic_terms` WHERE `TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL)
  ) AS at
),
offered AS (
  SELECT
    css.`TERM_CODE`,
    css.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    css.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    css.`SUBJECT_CODE`,
    css.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`,
    css.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    css.`SECTION_ID`,
    css.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    css.`TOTAL_UNITS`,
    css.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE`,
    css.`MEET_PLACE`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` css
),
offered_with_material AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    c.`STATUS_CHANGE` AS `MATERIAL_STATUS`
  FROM offered o
  LEFT JOIN `cis_course_catalog` c
    ON ( (c.`SUBJECT_ID` = o.`SUBJECT_ID` OR (c.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND c.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = o.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`))
         AND c.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` = o.`TERM_CODE` )
)
SELECT
  tay.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  tay.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  EXP(AVG(LN(s.`TOTAL_UNITS`))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM offered_with_material s
JOIN term_academic_years tay
  ON s.`TERM_CODE` = tay.`TERM_CODE`
WHERE
  s.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Mathematics'
  AND s.`MATERIAL_STATUS` = 'U'
  AND s.`TOTAL_UNITS` IS NOT NULL
  AND s.`TOTAL_UNITS` > 0
GROUP BY
  tay.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
  tay.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`
HAVING
  EXP(AVG(LN(s.`TOTAL_UNITS`))) >
    (
      SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(s2.`TOTAL_UNITS`)))
      FROM offered_with_material s2
      WHERE
        s2.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Mathematics'
        AND s2.`MATERIAL_STATUS` = 'U'
        AND s2.`TOTAL_UNITS` IS NOT NULL
        AND s2.`TOTAL_UNITS` > 0
    )
ORDER BY
  GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS DESC

rows.question: For each department, provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the department phone number. Only include departments that have at least one subject with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.

  -- use sample stddev (STDDEV) divided by sample mean (AVG) over subjects with TOTAL_UNITS > 0
  STDDEV(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS COEFFICIENT_OF_VARIATION,
  ed.OFFICE_PHONE AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS ccs

  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered

  ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

  ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WHERE ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
  AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS > 0
GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.OFFICE_PHONE

    s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,

rows.question: For each department that is degree-granting, has a department budget code above 100000, and is not the Political Science department, give the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of units for all those courses, and the number of unique subject codes associated with those courses. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH degree_granting_departments_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `SCHOOL_NAME`,
    `DEPT_BUDGET_CODE`
  FROM `sis_department`
  WHERE
    -- degree-granting: non-empty and not a false-like value
    `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`) <> ''
    AND LOWER(TRIM(`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`)) NOT IN ('f','false','0','n','no')
    -- DEPT_BUDGET_CODE must be numeric (allowing optional leading +/-, but require digits)
    AND TRIM(COALESCE(`DEPT_BUDGET_CODE`,'')) REGEXP '^[-+]?[0-9]+$'
), unioned_courses AS (
  -- course_catalog_subject_offered
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS dept_code,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(`SUBJECT_ID`,''), '::', COALESCE(`SUBJECT_NUMBER`,'')) AS course_id,
    COALESCE(`SUBJECT_ID`, `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`) AS subject_id,
    -- prefer TOTAL_UNITS when present, otherwise sum unit components
    CASE
      WHEN `TOTAL_UNITS` IS NOT NULL THEN `TOTAL_UNITS`
      ELSE COALESCE(`LECTURE_UNITS`,0)
           + COALESCE(`LAB_UNITS`,0)
           + COALESCE(`PREPARATION_UNITS`,0)
           + COALESCE(`DESIGN_UNITS`,0)
    END AS units
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`

  UNION ALL

  -- drupal_course_catalog
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS dept_code,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(`SUBJECT_ID`,''), '::', COALESCE(`SUBJECT_NUMBER`,'')) AS course_id,
    COALESCE(`SUBJECT_ID`, `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`) AS subject_id,
    CASE
      WHEN `TOTAL_UNITS` IS NOT NULL THEN `TOTAL_UNITS`
      ELSE COALESCE(`LECTURE_UNITS`,0)
           + COALESCE(`LAB_UNITS`,0)
           + COALESCE(`PREPARATION_UNITS`,0)
           + COALESCE(`DESIGN_UNITS`,0)
    END AS units
  FROM `drupal_course_catalog`

  UNION ALL

  -- cis_course_catalog
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS dept_code,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, COALESCE(`SUBJECT_ID`,'')), '::', COALESCE(`SUBJECT_NUMBER`,'')) AS course_id,
    COALESCE(`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, `SUBJECT_ID`) AS subject_id,
    CASE
      WHEN `TOTAL_UNITS` IS NOT NULL THEN `TOTAL_UNITS`
      ELSE COALESCE(`LECTURE_UNITS`,0)
           + COALESCE(`LAB_UNITS`,0)
           + COALESCE(`PREPARATION_UNITS`,0)
           + COALESCE(`DESIGN_UNITS`,0)
    END AS units
  FROM `cis_course_catalog`
)
SELECT
  d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  d.`SCHOOL_NAME`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uc.course_id) AS `NUM_UNIQUE_COURSES`,
  -- sum units; treat NULL units as 0 to avoid losing rows
  SUM(COALESCE(uc.units,0)) AS `TOTAL_UNITS`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uc.subject_id) AS `NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECT_CODES`
FROM degree_granting_departments_filtered d
JOIN unioned_courses uc
  ON uc.dept_code = d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`
WHERE
  CAST(d.`DEPT_BUDGET_CODE` AS SIGNED) > 100000
  AND d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` <> 'Political Science'
  AND d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` <> '17'
GROUP BY
  d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  d.`SCHOOL_NAME`
ORDER BY
  `TOTAL_UNITS` DESC

  AVG(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS AVG_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,

      )
      AND EXISTS (

          AND a.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P'
      )
    ORDER BY s_max.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER DESC

  ON (edn.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
      AND (edn.OFFICE_LOCATION = frs.ROOM_FULL_NAME
           OR edn.OFFICE_LOCATION = CONCAT(frs.BUILDING_NUMBER, ' ', frs.ROOM)
           OR edn.OFFICE_LOCATION = frs.SPACE_ID))
-- join to facility organizations to get budget code / organization id by matching dept/organization name or dept code
LEFT JOIN fclt_organizations_with_dlc AS fclt
  ON (
       -- try matching department number -> organization id
       (edn.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fclt.ORGANIZATION_ID = edn.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER)
       OR
       -- or match organization name from fac_rooms_space_area
       (frs.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fclt.ORGANIZATION_NAME = frs.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
     )
)
SELECT
  FIRST_NAME,
  LAST_NAME,
  EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  DEPARTMENT,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (
    ORDER BY LAST_NAME
    ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING
  ) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE_NEXT_2
FROM students_with_dept
WHERE STUDENT_YEAR = 'G'
  AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
  AND (IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' OR IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = '1')
ORDER BY LAST_NAME

rows.question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics), show the department name, each subject code, the subject code description, the graduate level of the subject, and the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that department's subject codes. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH degree_departments AS (
  -- only degree-granting departments, exclude Mathematics
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM sis_department sd
  WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics'
),
subjects_in_depts AS (
  -- subject codes tied to those departments (use cis_course_catalog as source of subject metadata)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    dd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    dd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    cis.SUBJECT_CODE,
    cis.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
    cis.GRADE_TYPE_DESC AS GRADUATE_LEVEL,
    cis.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM degree_departments dd
  JOIN cis_course_catalog cis
    ON cis.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
subject_course_numbers AS (
  -- get all non-null, non-empty course numbers for those subjects from course_catalog_subject_offered
  SELECT
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    s.SUBJECT_CODE,
    s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
    s.GRADUATE_LEVEL,
    co.SUBJECT_NUMBER
  FROM subjects_in_depts s
  JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered co
    ON co.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE
   AND co.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE
  WHERE co.SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(co.SUBJECT_NUMBER) <> ''
),
-- expand each SUBJECT_NUMBER into one row per character (generate numbers 1..max length)
nums AS (
  SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
  UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
  UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25
),
subject_number_chars AS (
  SELECT
    scn.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    scn.SUBJECT_CODE,
    scn.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
    scn.GRADUATE_LEVEL,
    scn.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    n.n AS pos,
    SUBSTRING(scn.SUBJECT_NUMBER, n.n, 1) AS ch,
    ASCII(SUBSTRING(scn.SUBJECT_NUMBER, n.n, 1)) AS ch_ascii
  FROM subject_course_numbers scn
  JOIN nums n
    ON n.n <= CHAR_LENGTH(scn.SUBJECT_NUMBER)
  WHERE CHAR_LENGTH(scn.SUBJECT_NUMBER) > 0
    AND SUBSTRING(scn.SUBJECT_NUMBER, n.n, 1) <> ''
    AND ASCII(SUBSTRING(scn.SUBJECT_NUMBER, n.n, 1)) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  snc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  snc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  snc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  snc.GRADUATE_LEVEL AS GRADUATE_LEVEL,
  AVG(snc.ch_ascii) AS AVG_ASCII_COURSE_NUMBER,
  VARIANCE(snc.ch_ascii) AS VAR_ASCII_COURSE_NUMBER
FROM subject_number_chars snc
GROUP BY
  snc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  snc.SUBJECT_CODE,
  snc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  snc.GRADUATE_LEVEL
ORDER BY
  snc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC,
  snc.SUBJECT_CODE ASC

rows.question: For each academic building at MIT with more than 10 rooms (excluding the 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'), list the building key, building name, building type, the number of historical records, the total assignable area from the building history, and the average assignable area per historical record, but only include buildings where the total assignable area is greater than the average total assignable area across all such buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_site_mit_current AS (
  SELECT
    f.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`BUILDING_NAME`, ''), b.`BUILDING_NAME`) AS BUILDING_NAME,
    f.`BUILDING_TYPE` AS BUILDING_TYPE,
    f.`NUM_OF_ROOMS` AS NUM_OF_ROOMS,
    f.`SITE` AS SITE
  FROM fac_building f
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = f.`BUILDING_NUMBER`
  WHERE
    f.`SITE` IS NOT NULL
    AND (f.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL OR f.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL)
),
building_history_agg AS (
  SELECT
    f.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS HISTORICAL_RECORD_COUNT,
    SUM(f.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`) AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA
  FROM fclt_building_hist f
  GROUP BY f.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`
),
filtered_buildings AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_TYPE,
    b.NUM_OF_ROOMS,
    bha.HISTORICAL_RECORD_COUNT,
    bha.TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    (bha.TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA / bha.HISTORICAL_RECORD_COUNT) AS AVG_ASSIGNABLE_AREA_PER_RECORD
  FROM buildings_site_mit_current b
  JOIN building_history_agg bha
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = bha.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE
    b.SITE = 'MIT'
    AND b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10
    AND NOT (b.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR b.BUILDING_KEY = '32')
)
SELECT
  BUILDING_KEY,
  BUILDING_NAME,
  BUILDING_TYPE,
  HISTORICAL_RECORD_COUNT,
  TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  AVG_ASSIGNABLE_AREA_PER_RECORD
FROM filtered_buildings
WHERE TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA > (
  SELECT AVG(TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) FROM filtered_buildings
)

rows.question: For each department, list the department name, the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), along with the school name and the department's full name. Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  COUNT(ms.MIT_ID) AS GRADUATE_STUDENT_COUNT
FROM (
  -- derive departments and degree-granting flag
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    COALESCE(sd.SCHOOL_NAME, '') AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subject_summary sse WHERE sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LIMIT 1) THEN 1
      WHEN sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL OR TRIM(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = '' THEN 0
      WHEN LOWER(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) RLIKE '(research|center|laboratory|lab|office|services|administration|administrative|alumni|development|library|museum|observatory|institute|center for|program office)' THEN 0
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, '')) RLIKE '(research|center|laboratory|lab|office|services|administration|administrative|alumni|development|library|museum|observatory|institute|center for|program office)' THEN 0
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fac_rooms fr WHERE fr.DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LIMIT 1) THEN 1
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employee_directory ed WHERE ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LIMIT 1) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING_NORMALIZED
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      s.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
      s.SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM subject_summary s

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
      so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
      so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM subject_offered so
    WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
      fr.DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
      NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM fac_rooms fr
    WHERE fr.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
      ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
      NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM employee_directory ed
    WHERE ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
  ) sd
) d
JOIN mit_student_directory ms
  ON (
       (d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT)
       OR (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER)
     )
WHERE
  d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING_NORMALIZED = 1
  AND ms.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G'
  AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME
ORDER BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

rows.question: For each department, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting and have at least one subject with more than 9 total units, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subjects AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cis.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(dc.SUBJECT_ID, ccc.SUBJECT_ID, cis.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(dc.TOTAL_UNITS, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, cis.TOTAL_UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    COALESCE(dc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cis.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COALESCE(dc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, cis.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR) AS IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR,
    COALESCE(dc.GRADE_TYPE, ccc.GRADE_TYPE, cis.GRADE_TYPE) AS GRADE_TYPE
  FROM drupal_course_catalog dc
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered ccc
    ON dc.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID
    AND dc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = ccc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog cis
    ON COALESCE(dc.SUBJECT_ID, ccc.SUBJECT_ID) = cis.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE COALESCE(dc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cis.ACADEMIC_YEAR) = '2022'

  UNION

  SELECT
    COALESCE(dc2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(dc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cis2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(dc2.SUBJECT_ID, ccc2.SUBJECT_ID, cis2.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(dc2.TOTAL_UNITS, ccc2.TOTAL_UNITS, cis2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    COALESCE(dc2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccc2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cis2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COALESCE(dc2.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, ccc2.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, cis2.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR) AS IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR,
    COALESCE(dc2.GRADE_TYPE, ccc2.GRADE_TYPE, cis2.GRADE_TYPE) AS GRADE_TYPE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccc2
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog dc2
    ON ccc2.SUBJECT_ID = dc2.SUBJECT_ID
    AND ccc2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = dc2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog cis2
    ON COALESCE(dc2.SUBJECT_ID, ccc2.SUBJECT_ID) = cis2.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE COALESCE(dc2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccc2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cis2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) = '2022'

  UNION

  SELECT
    COALESCE(dc3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis3.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(dc3.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccc3.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cis3.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(dc3.SUBJECT_ID, ccc3.SUBJECT_ID, cis3.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(dc3.TOTAL_UNITS, ccc3.TOTAL_UNITS, cis3.TOTAL_UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    COALESCE(dc3.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccc3.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cis3.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COALESCE(dc3.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, ccc3.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, cis3.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR) AS IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR,
    COALESCE(dc3.GRADE_TYPE, ccc3.GRADE_TYPE, cis3.GRADE_TYPE) AS GRADE_TYPE
  FROM cis_course_catalog cis3
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog dc3
    ON cis3.SUBJECT_ID = dc3.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered ccc3
    ON cis3.SUBJECT_ID = ccc3.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE COALESCE(dc3.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccc3.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cis3.ACADEMIC_YEAR) = '2022'
),
-- keep only rows with a known department name and numeric TOTAL_UNITS
subjects_clean AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    CAST(TOTAL_UNITS AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    GRADE_TYPE
  FROM subjects
  WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(TOTAL_UNITS) <> ''
),
-- filter to degree-granting subjects based on common grade-type indicators (as sis tables with explicit flag not present)
degree_subjects AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM subjects_clean
  WHERE GRADE_TYPE IS NULL
     OR GRADE_TYPE IN ('Degree','Degree Granting','Degree-granting','degree','DEGREE','Degree-granting','Degree Granting')
),
-- mark departments that have at least one subject with TOTAL_UNITS > 9 in 2022
dept_has_gt9 AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    MAX(CASE WHEN TOTAL_UNITS > 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_gt9
  FROM degree_subjects
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
-- aggregate per department but only include those with has_gt9 = 1 and applying exclusions
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
    (MAX(s.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS)) AS RANGE_TOTAL_UNITS,
    VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS VARIANCE_TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM degree_subjects s
  JOIN dept_has_gt9 dgt
    ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgt.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    AND ( (s.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL AND dgt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL) OR (s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dgt.DEPARTMENT_CODE) )
  JOIN (
    -- derive distinct department identifiers from the join to carry department name/code for final grouping
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM degree_subjects
  ) d
    ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    AND ( (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL) OR (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE) )
  WHERE dgt.has_gt9 = 1
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics'
    AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL OR d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18')
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  RANGE_TOTAL_UNITS,
  VARIANCE_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM dept_stats

rows.question: For each department, show the department name, department full name, the number of graduate students in that department whose department is degree granting, and the highest dense rank over the school code among those students, ordered by school code. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_full_name,
  COUNT(s.MIT_ID) AS num_graduate_students_degree_granting,
  MAX(dense_rank_by_school) AS max_dense_rank_over_school_code
FROM
  employee_directory d
LEFT JOIN (
  -- students analog: use drupal_employee_directory as student source (schema doesn't have 'student' table).
  -- treat MIT_ID as student key, and use EMPLOYEE_GROUP as STUDENT_LEVEL, HAS_ADDL_APPOINTMENT as IS_DEGREE_GRANTING proxy.
  SELECT
    dd.MIT_ID,
    dd.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    dd.EMPLOYEE_GROUP AS STUDENT_LEVEL,
    dd.HAS_ADDL_APPOINTMENT AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
    dd.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE,
    dd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    -- compute dense rank over school code (use HR_ORG_UNIT_ID as school code proxy)
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dd.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY dd.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS dense_rank_by_school
  FROM drupal_employee_directory dd
) s
  ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER
    AND s.STUDENT_LEVEL = 'Student'            -- treat 'Student' as graduate-level indicator if present
    AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
WHERE
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
  OR d.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = '18'
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
  d.OFFICE_LOCATION
ORDER BY
  d.OFFICE_LOCATION

rows.question: For each department, what is the department code, department name, and the highest number of enrolled students in any subject offered, for departments that are degree-granting and specifically for the Mathematics department, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH sis_department_degree_granting AS (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `DEPT_BUDGET_CODE`,
    `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
  FROM `sis_department`
),
subject_offered_latest_by_section AS (
  SELECT
    so.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY `SECTION_ID`
      ORDER BY COALESCE(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '') DESC, `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY` DESC
    ) AS section_row_rank
  FROM `subject_offered` so
),
subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_ID_SORT`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT`,
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `SCHOOL_CODE`,
    `SCHOOL_NAME`,
    SUM(COALESCE(`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_number,
    SUM(COALESCE(`CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`, 0)) AS total_cluster_enrollment_number,
    SUM(COALESCE(`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT`, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_credit,
    SUM(COALESCE(`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN`, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_listen,
    SUM(COALESCE(`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK`, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_first_week,
    SUM(COALESCE(`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK`, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_fifth_week,
    MAX(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS last_warehouse_load_date
  FROM `subject_summary`
  GROUP BY
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_ID_SORT`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT`,
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `SCHOOL_CODE`,
    `SCHOOL_NAME`
),
subject_summary_by_department AS (
  SELECT
    sols.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY` AS SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
    COALESCE(sols.`TERM_CODE`, eagg.`TERM_CODE`) AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(sols.`SUBJECT_ID`, eagg.`SUBJECT_ID`) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(sols.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`, ''), eagg.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(sols.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`, ''), eagg.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- canonical enrollment: prefer subject_offered's SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, fallback to aggregated total
    (COALESCE(
       NULLIF(sols.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`, ''),
       NULLIF(sols.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`, '0'),
       NULLIF(CAST(eagg.total_subject_enrollment_number AS CHAR), ''),
       eagg.total_subject_enrollment_number
     ) + 0) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
  FROM
    subject_offered_latest_by_section sols
    LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject eagg
      ON COALESCE(sols.`TERM_CODE`, '') = COALESCE(eagg.`TERM_CODE`, '')
      AND COALESCE(sols.`SUBJECT_ID`, '') = COALESCE(eagg.`SUBJECT_ID`, '')
  WHERE sols.section_row_rank = 1
  GROUP BY
    sols.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,
    COALESCE(sols.`TERM_CODE`, eagg.`TERM_CODE`),
    COALESCE(sols.`SUBJECT_ID`, eagg.`SUBJECT_ID`),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(sols.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`, ''), eagg.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(sols.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`, ''), eagg.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`),
    SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
)
SELECT
  d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  MAX(s.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`) AS MAX_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT
FROM sis_department_degree_granting d
JOIN subject_summary_by_department s
  ON s.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`
WHERE
  d.`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` = 'Y'
  AND d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Mathematics'
  AND CAST(COALESCE(d.`DEPT_BUDGET_CODE`, '0') AS SIGNED) BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000
  AND (
    s.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER` BETWEEN 1 AND 10
    OR CAST(COALESCE(d.`DEPT_BUDGET_CODE`, '0') AS SIGNED) >= 90000
  )
GROUP BY

  COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, ''), NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME, '')) AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  -- prefer canonical shorter name when available, else long name, else building number
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ''), NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, '')) AS BUILDING_NAME,

  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
  COUNT(fr.`FAC_ROOM_KEY`) AS `QUALIFYING_ROOM_COUNT_raw`,
  SUM(fr.`AREA`) AS `SUM_AREA_raw`,
  AVG(fr.`AREA`) AS `AVG_AREA_raw`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` fr
GROUP BY
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`
),

SELECT
  frs.`FAC_ROOM_KEY`,
  frs.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  frs.`FLOOR_KEY`,
  frs.`ROOM`,
  -- BUILDING_ROOM: canonical short identifier combining building number (if available) and room
  CASE
    WHEN frs.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND frs.`BUILDING_NUMBER` <> '' THEN CONCAT(frs.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, ' ', frs.`ROOM`)
    WHEN b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` <> '' THEN CONCAT(b.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, ' ', frs.`ROOM`)
    ELSE frs.`ROOM`
  END AS `BUILDING_ROOM`,
  frs.`AREA`,
  frs.`ACCESS_LEVEL`,
  frs.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
  frs.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
  frs.`DEPT_CODE`,
  frs.`ROOM_FULL_NAME`,
  -- prefer the room-level warehouse_load_date, fall back to building or fac_building if present
  COALESCE(frs.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, b.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, fb.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`) AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`

        SELECT
          r.BUILDING_KEY,
          r.ORGANIZATION_NAME,

      t.BUILDING_KEY
  ) AS bh
JOIN fac_building_basic b
  ON bh.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY
  bh.total_room_count DESC
LIMIT 10
