  COALESCE(ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY, NULL)  AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE,

  -- degree-granting indicator: infer true if department appears as OFFER_DEPT in subject offerings or if organization reports MAJOR_USE suggesting academic use
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sse
      WHERE sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE = fo.DEPT_CODE
      LIMIT 1
    ) THEN 'Y'
    WHEN fo.MAJOR_USE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fo.MAJOR_USE_DESC) <> '' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END                                      AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,

  -- most recent warehouse load date seen across source inputs for this department
  GREATEST(
    COALESCE(fo.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '0000-00-00'),
    COALESCE(ss.last_warehouse_load_date, '0000-00-00'),
    COALESCE(ed.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '0000-00-00')
  )                                        AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE

FROM
  -- primary source of departmental canonical info: fac_rooms_space_area exposes ORGANIZATION_KEY/NAME and DEPT_CODE
  fac_rooms_space_area fo

  -- left join subject-level summary to bring school code/name and recent load date (one row per department if exists)
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      -- pick the most recent school_code/name per department (if multiple terms)
      MAX(SCHOOL_CODE)   AS SCHOOL_CODE,
      MAX(SCHOOL_NAME)   AS SCHOOL_NAME,
      MAX(last_warehouse_load_date) AS last_warehouse_load_date
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
  ) ss
    ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = fo.DEPT_CODE

  -- employee directory contact normalized may provide department budget code / dept number
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
      DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      KRB_NAME,
      NULL AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
    FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
  ) ed
    ON ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME

GROUP BY
  fo.DEPT_CODE,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  fo.MINOR_ORGANIZATION,
  ss.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ss.SCHOOL_NAME,
  ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  fo.MAJOR_USE_DESC,
  fo.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  ss.last_warehouse_load_date,
  ed.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
)
SELECT
  dm.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  CONCAT(
    COALESCE(ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE, ''),
    COALESCE(ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, '')
  ) AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
FROM department_master dm
JOIN (
  SELECT
    sc.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    MAX(CAST(sc.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AS UNSIGNED)) AS max_cip
  FROM sis_course_description sc
  WHERE sc.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE <> ''
    AND sc.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
  GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT
) cmax ON cmax.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dm.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN sis_admin_department ad
  ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = dm.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE dm.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  AND dm.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics'
  AND cmax.max_cip > 120000
ORDER BY dm.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME

rows.question: For each building type, what is the building type name, the geometric mean of the area of rooms (AREA) in buildings of that type (considering only rooms with area greater than 0 and buildings with more than 0 rooms), and the average assignable area of those buildings, only including buildings that are academic buildings and are located at MIT? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_rooms_space_area AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fr.FLOOR,
    fr.FLOOR_KEY,
    fr.ROOM,
    fr.SPACE_ID,
    fr.MAJOR_USE_KEY,
    fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC,
    fr.USE_KEY,
    fr.USE_DESC,
    fr.MINOR_USE_KEY,
    fr.MINOR_USE_DESC,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION,
    fr.AREA,
    fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    fr.DEPT_CODE,
    fr.ACCESS_LEVEL,
    fr.LATITUDE_WGS,
    fr.LONGITUDE_WGS,
    fr.NORTHING_SPCS,
    fr.EASTING_SPCS,
    fr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
),
-- count rooms per building (including zero if no rooms)
building_room_counts AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(cr.room_count, 0) AS room_count,
    fb.BUILDING_TYPE,
    fb.SITE,
    fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA
  FROM fac_building fb
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      BUILDING_KEY AS FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
      COUNT(*) AS room_count
    FROM fac_rooms_space_area
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
  ) cr
    ON cr.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
),
-- only rooms with area > 0
fac_rooms_positive_area AS (
  SELECT
    FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    BUILDING_KEY,
    AREA
  FROM fac_rooms_space_area
  WHERE AREA > 0
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_TYPE AS BUILDING_TYPE,
  -- geometric mean of room AREA across all rooms (AREA>0) for buildings of this type and site,
  -- computed as EXP(AVG(LN(AREA))) over the set of room rows relevant
  EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_ROOM_AREA,
  -- average ASSIGNABLE_AREA across buildings of this type/site that have >0 rooms
  AVG(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS AVG_ASSIGNABLE_AREA
FROM building_room_counts b
-- include only buildings that match filters and have more than 0 rooms
JOIN fac_rooms_positive_area r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC'
  AND b.SITE = 'MIT'
  AND b.room_count > 0
GROUP BY b.BUILDING_TYPE

rows.question: For each department and school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units, and specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, school name, average, variance, stddev). Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subjects AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- carry a department identifier (use name as key)
    DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_KEY,
    -- treat TOTAL_UNITS as numeric; exclude nulls and <=0
    TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM cis_course_catalog
  WHERE TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL
    AND TOTAL_UNITS > 0
    AND DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
),
-- determine departments that grant degrees: assume departments present in cip or cip_with_version indicate degree-granting;
-- use cip.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE presence joined by DEPARTMENT_NAME ~ PROGRAM_TITLE is not reliable.
-- Instead interpret "grant degrees" as departments that appear in academic terms? Since schema lacks explicit flag,
-- approximate by requiring that department has at least one subject with EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE not null in course_catalog_subject_offered.
dept_has_degree AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM subjects s
  JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered c
    ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    s.DEPARTMENT_KEY,
    s.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM subjects s
  JOIN dept_has_degree d ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_KEY AS DEPARTMENT_KEY,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
    VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units,
    STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units
  FROM filtered_subjects
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
-- school is inferred from department naming convention: many department names include school; absent explicit mapping,
-- approximate SCHOOL as the first word before a colon or dash, else use NULL. We'll compute SCHOOL by parsing DEPARTMENT_NAME.
dept_with_school AS (
  SELECT
    ds.DEPARTMENT_KEY,
    ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ds.avg_total_units,
    ds.variance_total_units,
    ds.stddev_total_units,
    CASE
      WHEN INSTR(ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ':') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ':', 1))
      WHEN INSTR(ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ' - ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ' - ', 1))
      WHEN INSTR(ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ',') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ',', 1))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM dept_stats ds
),
-- compute per-school grand totals (aggregate across departments in that school)
school_totals AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_KEY,
    s.SCHOOL_NAME,
    AVG(f.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
    VARIANCE(f.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units,
    STDDEV(f.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units
  FROM filtered_subjects f
  JOIN dept_with_school dws ON dws.DEPARTMENT_NAME = f.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT SCHOOL_NAME FROM dept_with_school) s ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = dws.SCHOOL_NAME
  GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME
),
-- select Mathematics department specifically (Course 18) — use DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
math_row AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_KEY,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    avg_total_units,
    variance_total_units,
    stddev_total_units
  FROM dept_with_school
  WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
)
-- final union of department rows (with school inferred), school totals, and math row (math may already be in dept rows; include to ensure presence)
SELECT
  DEPARTMENT_KEY,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  avg_total_units,
  variance_total_units,
  stddev_total_units
FROM dept_with_school

UNION ALL

SELECT
  DEPARTMENT_KEY,
  SCHOOL_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  avg_total_units,
  variance_total_units,
  stddev_total_units
FROM school_totals

UNION ALL

SELECT
  DEPARTMENT_KEY,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  avg_total_units,
  variance_total_units,
  stddev_total_units
FROM math_row

rows.question: For each subject offered by departments in the School of Engineering (excluding Chemistry and Biology), what is the minimum number of enrolled students for that subject, the total number of departments offering such subjects, and whether the minimum enrollment is below 5 ('LOW_ENROLLMENT'), above 50 ('HIGH_ENROLLMENT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT'? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_ID,
  MIN(COALESCE(so.TOTAL_ENROLLMENT, 0)) AS MIN_ENROLLMENT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(so.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''))) AS NUM_OFFERING_DEPARTMENTS,
  CASE
    WHEN MIN(COALESCE(so.TOTAL_ENROLLMENT, 0)) < 5 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT'
    WHEN MIN(COALESCE(so.TOTAL_ENROLLMENT, 0)) > 50 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT'
  END AS ENROLLMENT_CATEGORY
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS so
WHERE (
        (so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'School of Engineering')
        OR so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL
      )
  AND COALESCE(so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.DEPARTMENT_NAME) NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
  AND so.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_ID
ORDER BY so.SUBJECT_ID

rows.question: For each DLC in the history department, provide the DLC name, the average and variance of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC (excluding organizations '138' and '250', and only considering organizations with non-null organization number and DLC key), and also report the total number of organizations per DLC that meet these criteria. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_rooms_space_area AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fr.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
    ff.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_KEY,
    fr.ROOM,
    fr.SPACE_ID,
    fr.MAJOR_USE_KEY,
    fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC,
    fr.USE_KEY,
    fr.USE_DESC,
    fr.MINOR_USE_KEY,
    fr.MINOR_USE_DESC,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION,
    fr.AREA,
    fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    fr.DEPT_CODE,
    fr.ACCESS_LEVEL,
    fr.LATITUDE_WGS,
    fr.LONGITUDE_WGS,
    fr.NORTHING_SPCS,
    fr.EASTING_SPCS,
    fr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_floor ff
    ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
),
fclt_organizations_with_dlc AS (
  SELECT
    frs.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS `FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
    frs.`DEPT_CODE` AS `DLC_KEY`,
    frs.`ORGANIZATION_NAME` AS `DLC_NAME`,
    frs.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`,
    frs.`ORGANIZATION_NAME` AS `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
    frs.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS `ORGANIZATION_ID`
  FROM fac_rooms_space_area frs
),
fac_organization_canon AS (
  SELECT
    `FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS `FAC_ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
    `ORGANIZATION_ID` AS `ORGANIZATION_NUMBER`,
    `ORGANIZATION_ID` AS `ORGANIZATION_ID`,
    `DLC_KEY` AS `DLC_KEY`,
    `DLC_NAME` AS `DLC_NAME`
  FROM fclt_organizations_with_dlc
),
master_dept_hierarchy_dlc_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    f.`DLC_KEY` AS `DLC_KEY`,
    TRIM(NULLIF(f.`DLC_NAME`, '')) AS `DLC_NAME`,
    CASE
      WHEN f.`DLC_KEY` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(f.`DLC_KEY`) <> '' THEN UPPER(TRIM(f.`DLC_KEY`))
      WHEN f.`DLC_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(f.`DLC_NAME`) <> '' THEN
        LEFT(
          TRIM(BOTH '_' FROM
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
              UPPER(TRIM(f.`DLC_NAME`)),
              '[^A-Z0-9]+',
              '_'
            )
          )
        , 64)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS `DLC_CODE`
  FROM fclt_organizations_with_dlc f
  GROUP BY
    f.`DLC_KEY`,
    TRIM(NULLIF(f.`DLC_NAME`, '')),
    CASE
      WHEN f.`DLC_KEY` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(f.`DLC_KEY`) <> '' THEN UPPER(TRIM(f.`DLC_KEY`))
      WHEN f.`DLC_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(f.`DLC_NAME`) <> '' THEN
        LEFT(
          TRIM(BOTH '_' FROM
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
              UPPER(TRIM(f.`DLC_NAME`)),
              '[^A-Z0-9]+',
              '_'
            )
          )
        , 64)
      ELSE NULL
    END
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(foc.`DLC_NAME`, md.`DLC_NAME`) AS `DLC_NAME`,
  -- AVG as exact numeric: cast to DECIMAL with sufficient precision but do not round further
  AVG(CAST(foc.`ORGANIZATION_NUMBER` AS DECIMAL(38,18))) AS `AVG_ORGANIZATION_NUMBER`,
  -- population variance = E[X^2] - (E[X])^2
  (
    AVG(CAST(foc.`ORGANIZATION_NUMBER` AS DECIMAL(38,18)) * CAST(foc.`ORGANIZATION_NUMBER` AS DECIMAL(38,18)))
    - POW(AVG(CAST(foc.`ORGANIZATION_NUMBER` AS DECIMAL(38,18))), 2)
  ) AS `VAR_ORGANIZATION_NUMBER`,
  COUNT(*) AS `ORGANIZATION_COUNT`
FROM fac_organization_canon AS foc
LEFT JOIN master_dept_hierarchy_dlc_lookup AS md
  ON foc.`DLC_KEY` = md.`DLC_KEY`
WHERE
  foc.`DLC_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(foc.`DLC_NAME`, md.`DLC_NAME`) IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(foc.`DLC_NAME`, md.`DLC_NAME`)) = LOWER('History')
  AND foc.`ORGANIZATION_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL
  -- exclude organization numbers '138' and '250' per requirement (use ORGANIZATION_ID which mirrors number)
  AND foc.`ORGANIZATION_ID` NOT IN ('138', '250')
GROUP BY COALESCE(foc.`DLC_NAME`, md.`DLC_NAME`)

rows.question: For each academic year, which Mathematics subject offered in regular terms starting after January 1, 2010 had the highest total units, and what was the range and variance of total units for that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH offered AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(ccat.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cis.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COALESCE(ccat.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, dc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, cis.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(ccat.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(ccat.SUBJECT_CODE, dc.SUBJECT_CODE, cis.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    COALESCE(ccat.SUBJECT_ID, dc.SUBJECT_ID, cis.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(ccat.TOTAL_UNITS, dc.TOTAL_UNITS, cis.TOTAL_UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    COALESCE(at.TERM_START_DATE, ap.TERM_START_DATE) AS TERM_START_DATE,
    COALESCE(at.IS_REGULAR_TERM, ap.TERM_INDICATOR) AS IS_REGULAR_TERM
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccat
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog dc
    ON ccat.SUBJECT_ID = dc.SUBJECT_ID AND ccat.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = dc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog cis
    ON ccat.SUBJECT_ID = cis.SUBJECT_ID AND ccat.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = cis.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN academic_terms at
    ON COALESCE(ccat.TERM_CODE, ccat.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE) = at.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN academic_term_parameter ap
    ON COALESCE(ccat.TERM_CODE, ccat.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE) = ap.TERM_CODE
  WHERE COALESCE(ccat.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'Mathematics'
    AND (
      (at.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(at.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') > DATE '2010-01-01')
      OR (ap.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(ap.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') > DATE '2010-01-01')
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(at.IS_REGULAR_TERM, ap.TERM_INDICATOR) IN ('Y','Yes','yes','y','1','TRUE','True')
      OR COALESCE(at.IS_REGULAR_TERM, ap.TERM_INDICATOR) = '1'
    )
),
per_year_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUM(CAST(TOTAL_UNITS AS DECIMAL(30,10))) AS SUM_UNITS,
    MIN(CAST(TOTAL_UNITS AS DECIMAL(30,10))) AS MIN_UNITS,
    MAX(CAST(TOTAL_UNITS AS DECIMAL(30,10))) AS MAX_UNITS,
    (MAX(CAST(TOTAL_UNITS AS DECIMAL(30,10))) - MIN(CAST(TOTAL_UNITS AS DECIMAL(30,10)))) AS RANGE_UNITS,
    VARIANCE(CAST(TOTAL_UNITS AS DECIMAL(30,10))) AS VAR_UNITS,
    COUNT(*) AS CNT
  FROM offered
  WHERE TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(TOTAL_UNITS) <> ''
  GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_ID
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    p.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    p.SUBJECT_CODE,
    p.SUBJECT_ID,
    p.SUM_UNITS,
    p.MIN_UNITS,
    p.MAX_UNITS,
    p.RANGE_UNITS,
    p.VAR_UNITS,
    p.CNT,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY p.SUM_UNITS DESC) AS rn
  FROM per_year_stats p
)
SELECT
  r.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  r.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT,
  r.SUBJECT_ID,
  r.SUM_UNITS AS TOTAL_UNITS_FOR_SUBJECT,
  r.RANGE_UNITS AS RANGE_OF_TOTAL_UNITS_IN_YEAR,
  r.VAR_UNITS AS VARIANCE_OF_TOTAL_UNITS,
  r.CNT AS RECORD_COUNT
FROM ranked r
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r.ACADEMIC_YEAR

rows.question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Political Science), list the department name, the total number of unique subject titles they offered with at least one enrolled student, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total row showing the total number of unique subject titles and total enrolled students across all its degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science). Show only the top 10 departments by unique subject count within each school. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH fac_rooms_space_area AS (
SELECT
  fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
  fr.BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  fr.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
  ff.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_KEY,
  fr.ROOM,
  fr.SPACE_ID,
  fr.MAJOR_USE_KEY,
  fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC,
  fr.USE_KEY,
  fr.USE_DESC,
  fr.MINOR_USE_KEY,
  fr.MINOR_USE_DESC,
  fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION,
  fr.AREA,
  fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  fr.DEPT_CODE,
  fr.ACCESS_LEVEL,
  fr.LATITUDE_WGS,
  fr.LONGITUDE_WGS,
  fr.NORTHING_SPCS,
  fr.EASTING_SPCS,
  fr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM fac_rooms fr
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_floor ff
  ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
),
subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS (
SELECT
  TERM_CODE,
  SUBJECT_ID,
  SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SCHOOL_CODE,
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_number,
  SUM(COALESCE(CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_cluster_enrollment_number,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_credit,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_listen,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_first_week,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_fifth_week,
  MAX(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS last_warehouse_load_date
FROM subject_summary
GROUP BY
  TERM_CODE,
  SUBJECT_ID,
  SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SCHOOL_CODE,
  SCHOOL_NAME
),
sis_degree_granting_departments_124 AS (
SELECT
  -- department code is the grain key
  COALESCE(sas.DEPARTMENT_CODE, fr.DEPT_CODE) AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,

  -- prefer department name from subject summary enrollment (authoritative for courses),
  -- fall back to fac_rooms department name when available
  COALESCE(NULLIF(sas.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fr.DEPT_CODE, '')) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,

  -- prefer school name from subject summary enrollment if present
  COALESCE(NULLIF(sas.SCHOOL_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION, ''), NULLIF(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')) AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,

  -- Normalize degree-granting indicator:
  -- If subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject reports any enrollment rows for the department
  -- we consider it degree-granting ('Y'). Otherwise, if fac_rooms_space_area exists for the dept we mark 'Y'.
  -- Else default to 'N'. This keeps literal 'Y' usable for joins/filters.
  CASE
    WHEN sas.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
    WHEN fr.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
FROM
  -- subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject provides departments that offer subjects (degree-granting signal)
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sas
  -- left join fac_rooms_space_area to bring in department info for units that have space but may not appear in course lists
  LEFT JOIN fac_rooms_space_area fr
    ON fr.DEPT_CODE = sas.DEPARTMENT_CODE

-- union additional departments that exist only in fac_rooms_space_area (rooms assigned to a dept)
UNION

SELECT
  -- when coming solely from fac_rooms_space_area, use its dept code/name
  fr.DEPT_CODE AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ''), fr.DEPT_CODE) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION, ''), NULLIF(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')) AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,
  'Y' AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
FROM fac_rooms_space_area fr
-- exclude departments already included via subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
WHERE fr.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sas2
    WHERE sas2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = fr.DEPT_CODE
  )
)
SELECT
  dept.SCHOOL_NAME,
  dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  dept_stats.UNIQUE_SUBJECT_COUNT,
  dept_stats.TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    s.SCHOOL_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS UNIQUE_SUBJECT_COUNT,
    SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) DESC) AS rn
  FROM sis_degree_granting_departments_124 s
  JOIN subject_summary ss
    ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
    AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17'
    AND ss.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0
  GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME
) AS dept_stats
JOIN sis_degree_granting_departments_124 dept
  ON dept.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE dept_stats.rn <= 10

UNION ALL

-- School grand totals (excluding Political Science)
SELECT
  s.SCHOOL_NAME,
  CONCAT(s.SCHOOL_NAME, ' - Grand Total') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS UNIQUE_SUBJECT_COUNT,
  SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM sis_degree_granting_departments_124 s
JOIN subject_summary ss
  ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
  AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17'
  AND ss.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0
GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME

ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, 
  -- ensure department rows (not grand total) come first by checking name pattern
  CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '% - Grand Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  UNIQUE_SUBJECT_COUNT DESC

rows.question: List the minimum department budget code, the sum of total units, and the number of unique courses for each department whose name includes 'Engineering', that are degree granting, and that are not the Mechanical Engineering department. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH sis_department_degree_granting_125 AS (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `DEPT_BUDGET_CODE`,
    `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
  FROM
    `sis_department`
  WHERE
    -- treat typical truthy text values as degree-granting; also accept numeric 1 or boolean TRUE
    `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`) <> ''
    AND (
      UPPER(TRIM(`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`)) IN ('Y','YES','1','TRUE')
      OR `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` = 1
      OR `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` = TRUE
      OR LENGTH(TRIM(`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`)) > 0  -- fallback: any non-empty value
    )
),
dept_total_units AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    SUM(COALESCE(TOTAL_UNITS, 0)) AS SUM_TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM (
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM cis_course_catalog
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM drupal_course_catalog
  ) t
  GROUP BY COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '')
),
dept_unique_courses AS (
  SELECT
    dept,
    COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS unique_course_count
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS dept,
           CONCAT(COALESCE(SUBJECT_CODE,''), '::', COALESCE(SUBJECT_NUMBER,'')) AS course_id
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS dept,
           CONCAT(COALESCE(SUBJECT_CODE,''), '::', COALESCE(SUBJECT_NUMBER,'')) AS course_id
    FROM cis_course_catalog
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS dept,
           CONCAT(COALESCE(SUBJECT_CODE,''), '::', COALESCE(SUBJECT_NUMBER,'')) AS course_id
    FROM drupal_course_catalog
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) u
  GROUP BY dept
)
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE,
  COALESCE(tu.SUM_TOTAL_UNITS, 0) AS SUM_TOTAL_UNITS,
  COALESCE(dc.unique_course_count, 0) AS UNIQUE_COURSE_COUNT
FROM
  sis_department_degree_granting_125 d
LEFT JOIN dept_total_units tu
  ON tu.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN dept_unique_courses dc
  ON dc.dept = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE
  UPPER(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE '%ENGINEERING%'
  AND UPPER(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING'
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  tu.SUM_TOTAL_UNITS,
  dc.unique_course_count

rows.question: From the top 10 IAP activities offered in the 2021 January term that are associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, display each activity's title, the term description, the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, and the subject title with the highest lecture units. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH cis_subject_catalog_basic AS (
  SELECT
    `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`                           AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_CODE`                                AS `SUBJECT_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_NUMBER`                              AS `SUBJECT_NUMBER`,
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`                             AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`                             AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`                               AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    COALESCE(`LECTURE_UNITS`, 0)                  AS `LECTURE_UNITS`,
    COALESCE(`LAB_UNITS`, 0)                      AS `LAB_UNITS`,
    COALESCE(`TOTAL_UNITS`, (COALESCE(`LECTURE_UNITS`,0) + COALESCE(`LAB_UNITS`,0))) AS `TOTAL_UNITS`,
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`                               AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    `EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`                         AS `EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`
  FROM `cis_course_catalog`
  WHERE `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND `SUBJECT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
    AND `DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_NUMBER`,
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `LECTURE_UNITS`,
    `LAB_UNITS`,
    `TOTAL_UNITS`,
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    `EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`
),
-- preaggregate activity-level enrollment/attendance from iap_subject_detail
iap_preagg AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `ACTIVITY_TITLE` AS `AD_ACTIVITY_TITLE`,
    MAX(COALESCE(`MAX_ENROLLMENT`,0)) AS `MAX_ENROLLMENT`,
    MAX(COALESCE(`ATTENDANCE`,0)) AS `ATTENDANCE`
  FROM `iap_subject_detail`
  GROUP BY `TERM_CODE`, `ACTIVITY_TITLE`
),
-- aggregate max lecture units per activity for Math department
s_agg AS (
  SELECT
    d.`TERM_CODE`,
    d.`ACTIVITY_TITLE`,
    MAX(COALESCE(c.`LECTURE_UNITS`,0)) AS `MAX_LECTURE_UNITS`
  FROM `iap_subject_detail` d
  JOIN cis_subject_catalog_basic c
    ON d.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = c.`SUBJECT_ID`
  WHERE c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Mathematics'
  GROUP BY d.`TERM_CODE`, d.`ACTIVITY_TITLE`
),
-- choose single subject (by highest lecture units, tie-breaker by SUBJECT_ID) per activity
s_top AS (
  SELECT
    t.`TERM_CODE`,
    t.`ACTIVITY_TITLE`,
    t.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    t.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    t.`LECTURE_UNITS`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.`TERM_CODE`, t.`ACTIVITY_TITLE` ORDER BY t.`LECTURE_UNITS` DESC, t.`SUBJECT_ID` ASC) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      d.`TERM_CODE`,
      d.`ACTIVITY_TITLE`,
      c.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
      c.`SUBJECT_ID`,
      COALESCE(c.`LECTURE_UNITS`,0) AS `LECTURE_UNITS`
    FROM `iap_subject_detail` d
    JOIN cis_subject_catalog_basic c
      ON d.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = c.`SUBJECT_ID`
    WHERE c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Mathematics'
  ) AS t
)
SELECT
  i.`AD_ACTIVITY_TITLE` AS `ACTIVITY_TITLE`,
  at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS `TERM_DESCRIPTION`,
  s_agg.`MAX_LECTURE_UNITS` AS `MAX_LECTURE_UNITS`,
  s_top.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS `TOP_SUBJECT_TITLE`
FROM iap_preagg AS i
JOIN academic_terms_all AS at
  ON i.`TERM_CODE` = at.`TERM_CODE`
JOIN s_agg
  ON s_agg.`TERM_CODE` = i.`TERM_CODE`
 AND s_agg.`ACTIVITY_TITLE` = i.`AD_ACTIVITY_TITLE`
JOIN s_top
  ON s_top.`TERM_CODE` = i.`TERM_CODE`
 AND s_top.`ACTIVITY_TITLE` = i.`AD_ACTIVITY_TITLE`
 AND s_top.`rn` = 1
WHERE
  at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` = '2021'
  AND at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` LIKE '%January%'
  AND s_agg.`MAX_LECTURE_UNITS` > 3
ORDER BY
  i.`MAX_ENROLLMENT` DESC,
  i.`ATTENDANCE` DESC,
  i.`AD_ACTIVITY_TITLE` ASC
LIMIT 10

rows.question: For each department, provide the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the corresponding school name, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). WITH subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,

    -- use TOTAL_UNITS from the source table if present; fall back to SUM of enrollment credit only if TOTAL_UNITS is not available
    -- assuming subject_summary has a TOTAL_UNITS column; if not, replace with appropriate column
    MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    MAX(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS last_warehouse_load_date
  FROM subject_summary
  GROUP BY
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,

department_subject_counts_and_stats AS (
  SELECT
    sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sa.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sa.SCHOOL_NAME,

    -- carry TOTAL_UNITS values through for aggregation; NULL TOTAL_UNITS will be ignored by STDDEV
    -- do not aggregate STDDEV here so we can filter departments by subject count first
    -- but compute STDDEV at department level below
    -- expose MAX(last_warehouse_load_date) to keep key columns useful in CTE
    MAX(sa.last_warehouse_load_date) AS last_warehouse_load_date
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sa
  GROUP BY
    sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sa.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sa.SCHOOL_NAME
)
SELECT

  -- compute population/sample stddev using STDDEV (MySQL STDDEV is sample standard deviation)
  STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS STDDEV_TOTAL_UNITS,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME
FROM department_subject_counts_and_stats d

GROUP BY

WITH academic_year_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    at.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    at.`TERM_START_DATE` AS TERM_START_DATE,
    at.`TERM_END_DATE` AS TERM_END_DATE,
    at.`IS_CURRENT_TERM` AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    at.`IS_REGULAR_TERM` AS IS_REGULAR_TERM
  FROM academic_terms AS at
  UNION
  SELECT
    ata.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    ata.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    ata.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    ata.`TERM_START_DATE` AS TERM_START_DATE,
    ata.`TERM_END_DATE` AS TERM_END_DATE,
    ata.`IS_CURRENT_TERM` AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    NULL AS IS_REGULAR_TERM
  FROM academic_terms_all AS ata

rows.question: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each academic year, classify the year as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if the enrolled_variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all years, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if it is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Show the academic year, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, and the variance_category. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH term_code_to_academic_year_norm AS (
  SELECT
    at.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ''), NULLIF(aa.ACADEMIC_YEAR, '')) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(at.TERM_DESCRIPTION), LOWER(aa.TERM_DESCRIPTION), '') LIKE '%fall%' THEN 'Y'
      WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(at.TERM_CODE), '') REGEXP '(^|[^0-9])(f|fall|fa)($|[^0-9])' THEN 'Y'
      WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(at.TERM_DESCRIPTION), '') LIKE '%sept%' THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS IS_FALL_TERM,
    COALESCE(at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, aa.TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    COALESCE(at.TERM_START_DATE, aa.TERM_START_DATE) AS TERM_START_DATE,
    COALESCE(at.TERM_END_DATE, aa.TERM_END_DATE) AS TERM_END_DATE,
    at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY AS ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY
  FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY FROM academic_terms) AS at
  LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM academic_terms_all) AS aa
    ON at.TERM_CODE = aa.TERM_CODE

  UNION

  SELECT
    aa2.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ''), NULLIF(aa2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, '')) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(aa2.TERM_DESCRIPTION), '') LIKE '%fall%' THEN 'Y'
      WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(aa2.TERM_CODE), '') REGEXP '(^|[^0-9])(f|fall|fa)($|[^0-9])' THEN 'Y'
      WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(aa2.TERM_DESCRIPTION), '') LIKE '%sept%' THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS IS_FALL_TERM,
    aa2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    aa2.TERM_START_DATE AS TERM_START_DATE,
    aa2.TERM_END_DATE AS TERM_END_DATE,
    NULL AS ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY
  FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM academic_terms_all) AS aa2
  LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM academic_terms) AS at2
    ON aa2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE
  WHERE
    aa2.TERM_CODE NOT IN (SELECT TERM_CODE FROM academic_terms)
),

per_year_stats AS (
  SELECT
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    MIN(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS min_enrolled,
    MAX(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrolled,
    -- population variance: E[X^2] - E[X]^2
    (AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER * s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER)
     - AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) * AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER)
    ) AS enrolled_variance
  FROM subject_summary s
  JOIN term_code_to_academic_year_norm t
    ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  WHERE t.IS_FALL_TERM IN ('Y', 'y', '1')
    AND s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0
    AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
  GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
),

avg_variance AS (
  SELECT AVG(enrolled_variance) AS avg_variance FROM per_year_stats
)

SELECT
  p.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  CONCAT(p.min_enrolled, ',', p.max_enrolled) AS enrolled_range,
  p.enrolled_variance,
  CASE
    WHEN p.enrolled_variance >= 1.2 * a.avg_variance THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE'
    WHEN p.enrolled_variance <= 0.8 * a.avg_variance THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE'
  END AS variance_category
FROM per_year_stats p
CROSS JOIN avg_variance a
ORDER BY p.ACADEMIC_YEAR

rows.question: For each academic year, list the academic year description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per academic term in that year for the Mathematics department (Course 18), and classify each year as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all years, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if it is at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH math_terms AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(`ACADEMIC_YEAR`, ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COALESCE(`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`, '') AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    COALESCE(`TERM_CODE`, '') AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, '') AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    COALESCE(`TOTAL_UNITS`, 0) AS TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM `cis_course_catalog`
  WHERE `DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Mathematics'
),
units_per_term AS (
  SELECT
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    TERM_CODE,
    TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS_PER_TERM
  FROM math_terms
  GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION
),
stats_per_year AS (
  SELECT
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    -- carry the description through; if empty string use NULL to avoid grouping surprises
    CASE WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = '' THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC END AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    MIN(TERM_CODE) AS ANY_TERM_CODE,
    MIN(TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS ANY_TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    MIN(TOTAL_UNITS_PER_TERM) AS MIN_TOTAL_UNITS_PER_TERM,
    MAX(TOTAL_UNITS_PER_TERM) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS_PER_TERM,
    (MAX(TOTAL_UNITS_PER_TERM) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS_PER_TERM)) AS units_range,
    VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS_PER_TERM) AS variance,
    STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS_PER_TERM) AS stddev,
    COUNT(*) AS terms_count
  FROM units_per_term
  GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, CASE WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = '' THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC END
),
avg_stddev AS (
  SELECT AVG(stddev) AS avg_stddev_across_years
  FROM stats_per_year
)
SELECT
  s.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  s.units_range,
  s.variance,
  s.stddev,
  CASE
    WHEN s.stddev >= (1.2 * a.avg_stddev_across_years) THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY'
    WHEN s.stddev <= (0.8 * a.avg_stddev_across_years) THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE'
  END AS variability_classification
FROM stats_per_year s
CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a
ORDER BY s.ACADEMIC_YEAR

    ata.`TERM_END_DATE` AS TERM_END_DATE,
    ata.`IS_CURRENT_TERM` AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    NULL AS IS_REGULAR_TERM
  FROM academic_terms_all AS ata
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM academic_terms at2
    WHERE at2.`TERM_CODE` = ata.`TERM_CODE`
      AND at2.`TERM_START_DATE` = ata.`TERM_START_DATE`
  )
)
SELECT
  s.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  s.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
  s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ayl.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE
  ) AS DEPARTMENT_SUBJECT_RANK,
  COUNT(*) OVER (
    PARTITION BY s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  ) AS TOTAL_SUBJECTS_IN_DEPARTMENT_FOR_TERM,
  s.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES AS SCHOOL_NAME
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered s
JOIN academic_year_lookup ayl
  ON s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = ayl.TERM_CODE
WHERE ayl.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2024'
  AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
  AND s.TOTAL_UNITS = 12
ORDER BY ayl.TERM_DESCRIPTION ASC, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC, s.SUBJECT_CODE ASC

rows.question: For each department, what is the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have library reserve material details with material status 'U'? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  MIN(a.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`) AS `MIN_ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
  SUM(c.`TOTAL_UNITS`) AS `SUM_TOTAL_UNITS`
FROM
  course_catalog_subject_offered c
JOIN
  cis_course_catalog cc
  ON c.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = cc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
JOIN
  academic_terms a
  ON c.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` = a.`TERM_CODE`
JOIN
  ( -- library reserve material detail simulated by joining through SUBJECT_ID and SECTION_ID if available;
    -- using COURSE subject identifiers from course_catalog_subject_offered to represent library_reserve_material_detail
    SELECT
      DISTINCT `SUBJECT_ID`, `SECTION_ID`
    FROM
      course_catalog_subject_offered
    WHERE
      1=1
  ) l
  ON c.`SUBJECT_ID` = l.`SUBJECT_ID` AND (c.`SECTION_ID` = l.`SECTION_ID` OR l.`SECTION_ID` IS NULL)
WHERE
  c.`IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM` = 'Y'
  AND cc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
  AND c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Mathematics'
  AND EXISTS (
    -- material status 'U' predicate: since no explicit library table exists in schema, infer from HASS_ATTRIBUTE or STATUS_CHANGE fields matching 'U'
    SELECT 1
    FROM cis_course_catalog ic
    WHERE ic.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = cc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
      AND (ic.`STATUS_CHANGE` = 'U' OR ic.`HGN_CODE` = 'U' OR ic.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` = 'U')
  )
GROUP BY
  c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`

rows.question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding Chemistry and Biology), what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, along with the department's full name, the school name, and the number of unique subjects offered by the department, considering only departments that offer more than 5 unique subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_offered_latest_by_section AS (
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY,
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,
    so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
    so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
    so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    so.COURSE_NUMBER,
    so.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
    so.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    so.SECTION_ID,
    so.IS_MASTER_SECTION,
    so.IS_LECTURE_SECTION,
    so.IS_LAB_SECTION,
    so.IS_RECITATION_SECTION,
    so.IS_DESIGN_SECTION,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    so.MEET_TIME,
    so.MEET_PLACE,
    so.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    so.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC,
    so.CLUSTER_LIST,
    so.HGN_CODE,
    so.HGN_CODE_DESC,
    so.FORM_TYPE,
    so.FORM_TYPE_DESC,
    so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    so.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    so.CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    so.EVALUATE_THIS_SUBJECT,
    so.IS_OSE_SUBJECT,
    so.IS_CREATED_BY_DATA_WAREHOUSE,
    so.SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY,
    so.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
    so.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY so.SECTION_ID
      ORDER BY COALESCE(so.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '') DESC, so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY DESC
    ) AS section_row_rank
  FROM subject_offered so
),
subject_offered_dedup AS (
  -- keep latest row per SECTION_ID (if SECTION_ID is NULL this will still produce rows; they won't be deduped)
  SELECT *
  FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section
  WHERE section_row_rank = 1
),
department_subject_enrollment_aggregate AS (
  SELECT
    so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS,
    AVG(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS AVG_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    VARIANCE(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS VARIANCE_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    STDDEV(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS STDDEV_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
  FROM subject_offered_dedup so
  WHERE so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
    AND so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
)
SELECT
  sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  dse.NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS,
  dse.AVG_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  dse.VARIANCE_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  dse.STDDEV_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
FROM department_subject_enrollment_aggregate dse
JOIN sis_department sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dse.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') -- exclude Chemistry (5) and Biology (7)
  AND dse.NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS > 5
ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE

rows.question: For each floor in the Stata building (building 32), what is the largest room square footage and the name of the building room with that largest square footage, for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24, with a largest room square footage greater than 100, and also display the total number of rooms on that floor that meet these criteria? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_rooms_space_area AS (
SELECT
  fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
  fr.BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  fr.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
  ff.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_KEY,
  fr.ROOM,
  fr.SPACE_ID,
  fr.MAJOR_USE_KEY,
  fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC,
  fr.USE_KEY,
  fr.USE_DESC,
  fr.MINOR_USE_KEY,
  fr.MINOR_USE_DESC,
  fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION,
  fr.AREA,
  fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  fr.DEPT_CODE,
  fr.ACCESS_LEVEL,
  fr.LATITUDE_WGS,
  fr.LONGITUDE_WGS,
  fr.NORTHING_SPCS,
  fr.EASTING_SPCS,
  fr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM fac_rooms fr
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_floor ff
  ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
),
fac_building_lookup AS (
SELECT
  fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`   AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.`BUILDING_NAME`, ''), NULLIF(fb.`BUILDING_NAME_LONG`, '')) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  fb.`BUILDING_NAME_LONG` AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  fb.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM
  fac_building fb
),
floor_room_aggregates AS (
SELECT
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`FLOOR`,
  MAX(fr.`AREA`) AS `MAX_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fr.`AREA` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `ROOM_COUNT_ON_FLOOR`
FROM
  fac_rooms_space_area fr
GROUP BY
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`FLOOR`
),
fac_rooms_cohort AS (
SELECT
  frsa.`FAC_ROOM_KEY` AS `FAC_ROOM_KEY`,
  frsa.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  frsa.`FLOOR` AS `FLOOR`,
  frsa.`ROOM` AS `BUILDING_ROOM`,
  frsa.`AREA` AS `ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,
  frsa.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` frsa
)
SELECT
  fra.FLOOR,
  fra.MAX_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  frc.BUILDING_ROOM,
  fra.ROOM_COUNT_ON_FLOOR
FROM floor_room_aggregates AS fra
JOIN fac_building_lookup AS fbl
  ON fbl.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fra.BUILDING_KEY
  AND fbl.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'
  AND fbl.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = '32'
JOIN fac_rooms_cohort AS frc
  ON frc.BUILDING_KEY = fra.BUILDING_KEY
  AND frc.FLOOR = fra.FLOOR
  AND frc.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = fra.MAX_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  AND frc.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24'
WHERE fra.BUILDING_KEY = '32'
  -- ensure the floor-level max exceeds 100 as requested
  AND fra.MAX_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100
ORDER BY fra.FLOOR ASC
